enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed with eyes closed. Turn over onto the other side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Rest head on the pillow. Turn over again. Stretch both legs under the blanket. Roll onto the back. Breathe slowly. Move the arm under the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Keep eyes closed. At 06:40 the phone alarm rings on the bedside table. Reach out the right hand. Pick up the phone. Press the alarm button to stop it. Put the phone back on the table. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the bed. Walk to the bedroom door. Open the door. Walk down the hallway to the bathroom. Enter the bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth for about two minutes. Rinse mouth with water from the tap. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Open the shower curtain. Turn the shower knob to the warm setting. Step into the shower. Wet hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the palm. Rub shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub soap over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse off the soap. Turn the shower knob off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the hook. Rub the hair with the towel. Dry the arms, chest and legs. Wrap the towel around the waist. Wipe the mirror with the hand. Turn off the light. Open the bathroom door. Walk back to Bedroom 4.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast (Member 3 is feeding the cat until 07:20)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton and the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a bowl and a plate. Close the cupboard. Pick up the bread slices. Put two slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the refrigerator again. Take out the butter. Close the door. Wait next to the counter. Take the toast out of the toaster when it pops up. Put the toast on the plate. Spread butter on the toast with a knife. Pour milk into the bowl. Pick up the cereal box. Pour cereal into the bowl. Put the cereal box back. Sit down at the kitchen table. Eat the cereal with a spoon. Bite the toast. Drink the milk from the bowl. Stand up. Carry the bowl, plate and spoon to the sink. Rinse them under the tap. Say "Morning" to Member 3 who is feeding the cat near the counter. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing study materials and reviewing chemistry lab notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 4. Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Open the chemistry lab notes file on the screen. Scroll down the document with the trackpad. Read the notes on titration. Type two corrections into the document. Save the file with a keyboard shortcut. Close the laptop lid. Pick up the backpack from the floor. Open the backpack zipper. Put the laptop into the backpack. Put the chemistry textbook into the backpack. Put the lab notebook into the backpack. Put a pen and a calculator into the front pocket. Zip the backpack closed. Pick up the lab coat from the chair back. Fold the lab coat. Put the lab coat into the backpack. Pick up the water bottle from the desk. Put the water bottle into the side pocket. Pick up the student card from the desk. Put the student card into the wallet. Put the wallet into the trouser pocket. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Turn off the desk lamp. Pick up the backpack. Walk out of the room.

Walk out of the house. Close the front door. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the trouser pocket. Walk along the footpath to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take out the phone. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus when it arrives. Touch the travel card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Put the backpack on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up at the campus stop. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the campus path. Pass the library building. Walk to the science building entrance. Push the glass door open. Enter the building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending chemistry lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the lecture theatre. Walk down the steps. Sit on a seat in the middle row. Take the laptop out of the backpack. Open the laptop. Turn it on. Open the note-taking file. Type the lecture heading. Type notes while the lecturer speaks. Raise the hand to ask a question. Speak the question to the lecturer. Write down the answer. Take out the water bottle. Unscrew the cap. Drink water. Screw the cap back on. Put the bottle back into the backpack. Close the laptop at the end of the lecture. Put the laptop into the backpack. Stand up. Walk out of the lecture theatre. Walk to the tutorial room. Sit at a bench with a lab partner. Pick up the worksheet from the bench. Read the instructions. Solve the calculation problems with the calculator. Write the answers on the worksheet. Hand the worksheet to the tutor. Say "Thank you" to the tutor. Pack the calculator and notebook into the backpack. Stand up. Walk out of the room.

Walk to the campus food court. Join the queue at the counter. Take out the wallet from the pocket. Order a chicken rice bowl. Tap the bank card on the payment terminal. Put the wallet back into the pocket. Pick up the tray with the food. Walk to an empty table. Put the tray down. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice. Drink water from the cup. Take out the phone. Scroll through messages while eating. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return rack. Put the tray on the rack. Walk out of the food court. Walk towards the lecture hall.

Walk into the lecture hall. Sit on a seat near the front. Take the notebook and pen out of the backpack. Open the notebook to a blank page. Write the date at the top of the page. Listen to the lecturer. Write down the key formulas. Draw a diagram of the reaction mechanism. Raise the hand to ask about the mechanism. Write down the lecturer's answer. Turn the page. Copy the slide numbers. Put the pen down. Close the notebook at the end of the lecture. Put the notebook and pen into the backpack. Stand up. Walk out of the lecture hall.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a part-time shift as a lab assistant
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the chemistry laboratory. Push the lab door open. Enter the laboratory. Put the backpack into the locker. Take out the lab coat. Put on the lab coat. Put on safety glasses. Put on the gloves. Pick up the clipboard with the task list. Read the tasks. Walk to the bench. Pick up the beaker. Place the beaker on the balance. Record the mass on the clipboard. Pick up the pipette. Draw up the solution. Release the solution into the beaker. Turn on the magnetic stirrer. Adjust the speed knob. Wait for the solution to mix. Turn off the stirrer. Pick up the pH meter. Dip the probe into the beaker. Read the pH value. Write the value on the clipboard. Rinse the probe with distilled water. Wipe the bench with a cloth. Carry the samples to the storage shelf. Place the samples in the rack. Take off the gloves and put them in the bin. Take off the safety glasses. Take off the lab coat. Hang the lab coat on the hook. Open the locker. Take out the backpack. Walk out of the laboratory. Say "See you tomorrow" to the supervisor.

Walk to the bus stop near the campus. Stand at the stop. Take out the phone. Check the bus timetable. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Touch the travel card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on an empty seat. Put the backpack on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up at the home stop. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk along the footpath. Turn at the corner. Walk to the front door. Take out the key from the pocket. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner (Member 5 is also in the kitchen finishing dinner until 18:50)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Put the backpack on the floor next to the cupboard. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables, eggs and chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Put the ingredients on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a pan and a bowl. Close the cupboard. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Pick up the knife from the block. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Put the vegetables into the pan. Stir with the spatula. Crack two eggs into the bowl. Beat the eggs with chopsticks. Pour the eggs into the pan. Stir again. Take out a plate. Put the food onto the plate. Turn off the induction cooker. Say "Hi" to Member 5 who is finishing dinner at the table. Carry the plate to the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the food. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the plate and pan to the sink. Rinse them under the tap. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying and completing chemistry assignments on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 4. Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Log in with the password. Open the browser. Open the university assignment page. Read the assignment questions on the screen. Take the notebook out of the backpack. Open the notebook. Solve a calculation with the calculator. Type the answer into the document. Scroll down the page. Repeat the calculation for the second question. Type the answer. Draw a structure in the chemical drawing software. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out a bottle of water. Close the door. Walk back to Bedroom 4. Sit down. Unscrew the bottle cap. Drink water. Screw the cap back on. Continue typing the assignment. Check the word count. Save the file. Submit the assignment on the webpage. Close the browser. Close the laptop lid. Turn off the desk lamp. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the shower knob. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms and legs. Rinse the body. Wash the hair with shampoo. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower knob. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body. Put on the pyjamas. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Put the toothbrush back. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk to the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV to relax with Member 3 (shared living room time)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button. Change the channel with the remote button. Put the remote on the sofa armrest. Watch the program on the screen. Say "How was your day?" to Member 3 sitting next to him. Listen to Member 3's answer. Talk about the lab shift. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Scroll through messages. Put the phone down on the armrest. Laugh at the program. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out a cup of yoghurt. Close the door. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Open the yoghurt lid. Eat the yoghurt with a spoon. Put the empty cup on the coffee table. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Stand up. Walk to Bedroom 4. Say "Good night" to Member 3.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and reviewing notes before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 4. Walk to the bed. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pick up the chemistry textbook from the bedside table. Open the book to the marked page. Read the notes on organic reactions. Turn the page. Underline a formula with a pencil. Turn another page. Close the book. Put the book back on the bedside table. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pick up the phone from the desk. Check the alarm setting. Set the alarm to 06:40. Put the phone on the bedside table. Turn off the desk lamp. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body.

Lie in bed with eyes closed. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Rest the head on the pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the back. Move the arm under the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Keep eyes closed. Remain still in bed.
